description: Defines classes and interfaces for OpenGL query objects within the ANGLE project, including QueryGL, StandardQueryGL, and SyncQueryGL, with methods for managing query lifecycle and results.

classes.name: QueryGL
classes.description: Abstract base class for OpenGL query objects, providing interface for pausing and resuming queries.

classes.name: StandardQueryGL
classes.description: Concrete implementation of QueryGL for standard OpenGL queries, managing query lifecycle and results.

classes.name: SyncQueryGL
classes.description: Implementation of QueryGL for synchronized queries, supporting query support check and synchronization.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the query, ending it and storing its ID for later readback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused query by generating and starting a new query.

methods.name: queryCounter
methods.description: Records a timestamp or counter for the query.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the query in various data types.

methods.name: isResultAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the query result is available.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes pending queries to ensure results are available.

methods.name: getResultBase
methods.description: Template method to get query result in a specific data type.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if SyncQueryGL is supported given the functions.
